description: §13.2 — two independent whole-result cell writes of server calls, `@a = one(1); @b = two(2)`, followed by a read of both. impl#1 runs the two calls concurrently (a Promise.all batch) and lands the writes in source order before the read, so #indep yields `indep:7,7` with the stub answering 7 for both fns. The observable contract pinned here is the SEQUENCING half (the read sees both writes); whether the calls overlap is timing, which this harness does not observe.
rationale: §13.2: "Independent server calls in the same function body SHALL be parallelized in generated code unless there is a data dependency between them" and dependent operations SHALL be sequenced with `await`. The read `@seen = … @a … @b` depends on both writes, so it must observe both resolved values whatever the scheduling of the two calls.
